## Which verb prints a value in its default format?

- [ ] %d
  > %d prints integers; given anything else, it prints an error marker instead.
- [x] %v
  > %v prints any value in its default format.
- [ ] %q
  > %q prints a string in double quotes, which is not its default format.

## Does fmt.Println end its output with a newline?

- [x] Yes
  > Println always ends what it prints with a newline.
- [ ] No
  > That is fmt.Print, which adds no newline.
